input.text:
We heard back from Kingsgate University London's own Student Finance office, and I'm very sorry to say the news is not good. They have no applicant or student named Mariam Aslam in their records, and no offer was ever issued under reference KGU/INT/2026/77812. The letter Mr. Faraz Siddiqui sent is not from the university.

This is a scam designed to look real, and it is absolutely not your fault. Nothing has been paid through CarryPay, and we will not be making any payment to him or to Global Pathways Education.

Please do not send him any more money. Keep the offer letter, your messages and any receipts as evidence, and report it to the police — the university has also alerted their own fraud team. If you like, we can help you organise the evidence for that report.

input.text:
No — please do not send anything to Faraz, not now and not to any account he gives you. This is the same scam, just with more pressure and a new bank account.

We already checked with Kingsgate University London's own Student Finance office: there is no offer and no applicant named Mariam Aslam. So there is no place to lose — nothing will be cancelled tonight, because the offer was never real.

A university never asks for payment to a personal account, and never has an agent "pass on" tuition. Nothing has been paid through CarryPay, and we will not pay him.

Please don't send him any more money or give him account, card or passport details. Keep the letter, his messages and any receipts, and report it to the police. We can help organise the evidence if you like.
